author: eliza
source: his 2026-11-11 15:22 "lets do a probe first to check its ok", before rebuilding Jessica's 99 parsecs and 16 minLevel recipes (her 4a60b2b, on Eliza's 3c81f6a)
_note: DISTANCE PROBE d1: v1's talk with no vendor, plus place.parsecs 12 (Jessica's easy/med cap) and minLevel 2 (passes for any real character).

What a play answers: (1) does the board still DEAL it with both gates on (a place that cannot fill is never dealt, silently); (2) is the site always within 12 parsecs of where he took it. Take it a few times from boards in different systems and look where it sends him.
d2 follows on his word: the same with minLevel 300, which must NOT deal. The test node is emptied by each build, so they go one at a time.
Every voiced line is v1's (w1's), cached. Pay easy.
